title: Genesis Bible Quiz - Chapter 50
description: Ten questions on Genesis 50: the mourning and burial of Jacob, Joseph's words to his brothers and Joseph's death.

questions.text: What did Joseph command the physicians to do with his father?
questions.explanation: Joseph commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father, and they embalmed Israel.

questions.text: For how many days did the Egyptians weep for Israel?
questions.explanation: Forty days were used for the embalming, and the Egyptians wept for Israel for seventy days.

questions.text: What did Pharaoh say when Joseph asked to bury his father in Canaan?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh said, "Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear."

answers.text: "Your father must be buried here in Egypt."
"Send your brothers, but you must stay with me."
"You may go after the harvest is gathered."
"Go up, and bury your father, just like he made you swear."

questions.text: What did the company leave behind in the land of Goshen?
questions.explanation: All the house of Joseph, his brothers and his father's house went up, leaving only their little ones, their flocks and their herds in Goshen.

answers.text: Their little ones, flocks and herds

questions.text: Where did they mourn with a very great and severe lamentation, beyond the Jordan?
questions.explanation: They came to the threshing floor of Atad, beyond the Jordan, and there they lamented greatly; Joseph mourned for his father seven days.

answers.text: At the threshing floor of Atad

questions.text: What name was given to the place because of the mourning of the Egyptians?
questions.explanation: The Canaanites called it "a grievous mourning by the Egyptians," so the place was named Abel Mizraim.

questions.text: What did Joseph's brothers fear after their father died?
questions.explanation: They said, "It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him."

answers.text: That Pharaoh would send them out of Egypt
That Joseph would pay them back
That the Canaanites would attack them

questions.text: What did Joseph say God meant by what his brothers had done?
questions.explanation: Joseph said, "You meant evil against me, but God meant it for good, to save many people alive."

answers.text: He meant it to punish the Egyptians
He meant it to test his brothers' honesty
He meant it to make Joseph king of Canaan
He meant it for good, to save many people alive

questions.text: How old was Joseph when he died?
questions.explanation: Joseph died being one hundred ten years old, and he was embalmed and put in a coffin in Egypt.

questions.text: What did Joseph make the children of Israel swear?
questions.explanation: Joseph took an oath from them, saying, "God will surely visit you, and you shall carry up my bones from here."

answers.text: That they would carry up his bones from Egypt
That they would never leave Egypt
That they would bury him in Goshen
That they would serve Pharaoh faithfully
